name: paper-research-corpus
title: Terminology evidence corpus for the paper/research collection
description: JSON Table schema for the per-paper metadata files in meta/*.json. Each instance file describes one paper in the corpus: bibliographic details, the retrieved artifact's checksum, its abstract, the terminology evidence quotes extracted from that artifact, and the two OCR passes.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Stem shared by the pdf, meta, and OCR files. Convention: {year}-{venue}-{firstauthor}-{slug}.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Paper title as printed on the retrieved artifact.

fields.name: Authors
fields.description: Author list as printed on the retrieved artifact.

fields.name: Year
fields.description: Publication year of the retrieved version.

fields.name: Venue
fields.description: Full venue of the retrieved version (conference proceedings, journal, technical report, preprint service, or book).

fields.name: Venue type
fields.description: One of: conference, journal, tech-report, preprint, book-chapter.

fields.name: Canonical URL
fields.description: Publisher or canonical record for the work.

fields.name: Source URL
fields.description: URL the artifact was actually retrieved from.

fields.name: Provenance note
fields.description: Mirror, rendering, or other retrieval caveat; absent when the artifact is the publisher's own file.

fields.name: File
fields.description: Path of the artifact relative to this directory (pdf/<id>.pdf).

fields.name: SHA-256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the artifact file; the identity the evidence quotes are verified against.

fields.name: Pages
fields.description: Page count of the artifact.

fields.name: Bytes
fields.description: Size of the artifact file in bytes.

fields.name: Abstract
fields.description: The paper's abstract, transcribed from the retrieved artifact.

fields.name: Abstract source
fields.description: Whether the abstract text is the paper's own abstract or a stand-in used because the genre has none.

fields.name: Terminology evidence
fields.description: Quotes from the artifact that instantiate the corpus's terminology (critical path, normal case/operation, synchronous disk writes, fast/slow path, stable storage). Each entry carries the quote, its location, and the terms it evidences. Every quote is verified against the artifact named by SHA-256.

fields.name: Terminology note
fields.description: Caveat on how the paper's terms are used, when needed to prevent misreading (e.g. fast path meaning message rounds rather than disk placement).

fields.name: Mistral OCR model
fields.description: Model used for the Mistral OCR pass (mistral-ocr-latest, the same model as the paper's own build gate).

fields.name: Mistral OCR output
fields.description: Path of the Mistral OCR markdown relative to this directory (ocr-mistral/<id>.md).

fields.name: Mistral OCR chars
fields.description: Character count of the Mistral OCR output.

fields.name: Tesseract version
fields.description: Tesseract release used for the local OCR pass.

fields.name: Tesseract output
fields.description: Path of the Tesseract OCR text relative to this directory (ocr-tesseract/<id>.txt).

fields.name: Tesseract chars
fields.description: Character count of the Tesseract OCR output.
